purpose: GT-only trajectory design for the frozen-8DNA teaset study. Written before any moved-state neural render. Not the locked protocol.
camera_lighting: upstream scenes/teaset get_scene(res) defaults: camera theta=60 phi=160 r=2.5 target (0,0.2,0), fov 35; envmap textures/envmap.exr rotated 90 deg about y; reference integrator prb max_depth -1 rr_depth 5
mover: teapot2 (milk pot); translation along the flat tray floor only
null_control_rule: Exactly one of T1a/T1b becomes T1. A candidate is eligible only if it keeps tray-floor contact, clears the tray rim and every other part along its whole sweep. Among eligible candidates choose the one with the smaller interaction-ROI GT change (display MAE vs T0, seed set A). It qualifies as a low-interaction control only if that change is at most 25% of T3's. If neither qualifies, the batch reports that no null control was found instead of relabelling a state.
redesign_rule: If T2 and T3 both fail the physical-signal gate, one GT-only redesign is allowed before any moved-state neural render.
